decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording retention of individual JST connectors rather than one consolidated connector; no additional state change is needed.
Connector consolidation does not change the main-board power-source OR-ing method, sources, or selection behavior.
The decision to retain individual JST connectors leaves the existing panel-control connector coverage, wiring, and GPIO mappings valid without modification.
The connector architecture decision does not alter any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The candidate already specifies individual output connectors for each sensor; retaining individual JST cables reaffirms rather than changes that topology.
Retaining individual connectors does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, placement, or current-coverage semantics.
The connector architecture decision does not affect the addressable LEDs' supply voltage, data-level handling, or power-control logic.
The decision does not alter the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
The connector decision does not affect the buzzer type or accepted component selection.
Retaining individual JST connectors does not change the requirement to expose unused ESP32 pins through through-holes.
The enclosure rationale is consistent with the existing sensor-board orientation and cable-access rules but establishes no new sensor-board layout value.
The existing separate interboard power and signal connectors remain valid; rejecting a consolidated fan-out connector does not change their types, signals, or pin-order policy.
